name: Warspace
summary: Warspace is a free first-person tactical shooter that runs in the browser, with nothing to install. Two teams fight over bomb sites in 5v5 and 2v2 matches: one life a round, the Ts plant the C4, the CTs defend or defuse it. Every map is built on the same 55-metre planet, so the horizon is close and fights come over the curve; a lap takes about a minute. The guns follow Counter-Strike 1.6's numbers and the knife and grenades follow CS:GO's. Play against bots in practice, open casual rooms with friends, climb 18 ranked tiers with a Discord account, and build and publish your own maps in the in-game editor, CREATORS. Warspace is independent and not affiliated with Valve.
